msg: No engines.node field: npm installs this package on any Node line, including end-of-life Node 18 and Node 20.
engines.node lower bound still admits an end-of-life Node line.
engines.node lower bound is a Node line that reaches end of life within 180 days.
volta.node pins an end-of-life Node line for every contributor and CI job that uses Volta.
@types/node targets an end-of-life Node line, so the type checker allows APIs your engines floor should not promise.
packageManager pins npm older than 9.5.0 while provenance is on; npm documents 9.5.0+ for provenance.
No license field: users cannot tell under what terms they may use the package.
license is an object or a licenses array; npm documents this style as deprecated, not valid metadata.
license is not an SPDX license identifier or SPDX expression.
license uses a deprecated SPDX identifier; the current list splits it into -only and -or-later.
license is UNLICENSED but private is not true; npm suggests private: true to prevent accidental publication.
No repository field: npm repo cannot find the source and provenance has nothing to match.
publishConfig.provenance is true but there is no repository; npm needs a public repository that matches where you publish from.
repository is shorthand; npm normalizes it to the object form and warns during npm publish.
repository.url is a browser page or plain http URL, not a URL a VCS program can use without modification.
repository.url and homepage/bugs name the same repo with different letter case; provenance matches the repository case-sensitively.
Scoped package publishes with provenance but publishConfig.access is not public; npm documents --access public for a first provenance publish.
